concept.title: People by age band
concept.shortdesc: People described mainly by age or age range, such as adults, teenagers, juniors, people over a minimum age, or everyone of all ages.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Adults, usually stated with a minimum age of 16, 18 or 19, including male adults.
: Services open to everyone regardless of age, from young children to older people.
: Junior members or players, typically school-age children (around 4 to 16), as used by clubs and sports groups.
: Services open to both adults and children or teens, naming the two groups side by side.
: People whose only stated requirement is a minimum age of 16.
: People above a stated minimum age below 16 (for example 4, 8, 12 or 13) with no upper age limit.
: People whose only stated requirement is being 18 or older.
: Teens and teenagers, including preteens, teens with a particular condition, and teens alongside adults.
: Boys, or boys and girls, of school age, often given with an age range or school years.
: Children and teenagers described only by an age band such as 11-18 or 8-11, or by school year.
: Young people described as such with an age band mostly between 8 and 18, including any young person.
